answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 24360 Country: Pakistan Title: If someone is praying Sunnah, while Iqamah is called for Fard, what should he do? break the salah of sunnah and join Jama't for Fard or complete sunnah and then join Fard? Question: If someone is praying Sunnah, while Iqamah is called for Fard, what should he do? break the salah of sunnah and join Jama't for Fard or complete sunnah and then join Fard? Answer ID: 24360 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1268/1268/M=1431) If one is offering fajar sunnah then one should complete it. And if it is the four rakah sunnah before Zuhar or Isha and the jamah started, if iqamah was started after starting the sunnah salah, in this case, one should join the jamah and leave the sunnah. And if he had completed one rakah he should complete the second rakah and then join the salah and if he had completed the third rakah he should complete the fourth one and then join the jamah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
